Who I Am

The story behind the numbers

"I don't manage projects. I build movements, ecosystems, and organizations that outlast my involvement."

I am a transformation executive who has spent 20+ years building things at national, regional, and multinational scale - from government flagship initiatives to humanitarian programs in refugee camps, from VVIP summits attended by Heads of State to marketing campaigns with regional influencers.

I have been trusted to advise UAE Ministers of AI, Economy, Cabinet Affairs, and Future. I negotiated bilateral government agreements with Jordan, Uzbekistan, Egypt, and Senegal. I sat across the table from Microsoft's global CEO Satya Nadella to discuss strategic partnerships. And I have stood in Zaatari refugee camp to extend digital education to Syrian refugees.

One Million Arab Coders is the best proof of what I do. I took a concept and turned it into the largest digital empowerment initiative in Arab world history - building the platform, team, partnerships with Google and Microsoft, brand, marketing campaigns, government relationships, and operational model across five countries.

1.2 million registered learners. Replicated in Jordan with the Crown Prince Foundation. A national government award from Uzbekistan. A coding track for Syrian refugees in Zaatari camp.

That is what I build. Not just programs - movements with lasting impact.

What This Looks Like in Practice

Six chapters of delivery

Each one built from zero. Each one with real outcomes.

Dubai Culture & Arts Authority·2023 – Present
Built a Creative Digital Ecosystem from the Ground Up
Designed and led the development of a city-wide creative digital ecosystem for Dubai - connecting artists, cultural institutions, creative entrepreneurs, and government entities through a unified digital platform. Concept creation, platform strategy, partner onboarding, design-thinking, stakeholder alignment across 6 government entities, and building the operational model that sustains the ecosystem beyond the initial launch.
ADXP Consultancy·2023 – Present
PMO Director - AED 1.27B Portfolio ROI
Running the central PMO for Dubai Police - 23 strategic initiatives, AED 1.27B in combined investment, direct accountability to executive leadership for delivery outcomes and ROI. Built the governance model, the reporting frameworks, the team structures, and the performance culture. Result: 23% improvement in strategic KPI attainment. Also designed an AI-powered PMO solution - connecting strategic objectives, KPIs, idea intake, portfolio prioritization, and predictive insights - and led AI strategy and use-case prioritization for a city-wide digital ecosystem platform, moving it from concept toward prototype and procurement.
Dubai Future Foundation·2016 – 2023
Built and Ran a National-Scale Operation from Scratch
One Million Arab Coders started as a concept. I built the team, the platform, the partnerships, the brand, and the operations. Within 3 years it reached 1.2 million registered learners across 5 countries. Owned everything - product, marketing, government relations, sponsorship, events, and P&L accountability. Secured Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Oracle, and SAP as delivery partners.
Dubai Future Foundation·7 Consecutive Years
Led Events and Campaigns at Head-of-State Level
Led programme and operational delivery for the World Government Summit for 7 years - one of the world's most prestigious government forums, attended by Heads of State, Prime Ministers, Kings, Ministers, and VVIP delegations from 100 countries. Ran the teams, the content strategy, the VVIP partner relationships, the brand positioning, and on-stage execution at the highest protocol level. In parallel, served as a direct advisor to UAE Ministers of AI, Economy, Cabinet Affairs, and Future.
Dubai Future Foundation·2016 – 2023
Built an Innovation Ecosystem and Ran Its Brand
Managed the Dubai Future Accelerators - sourcing, evaluating, and onboarding 40+ global technology companies including Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Oracle, and SAP. Designed collaboration models, structured partnerships, ran PR and marketing campaigns, and ensured each cohort delivered measurable value to government clients.
Multiple Programs·2015 – Present
Built and Delivered Programs at Regional and National Scale
Hands-on experience building and launching digital platforms - from the One Million Arab Coders learning platform (1.2M users) to DCAA's city-wide digital creative ecosystem. Worked with engineering teams, product managers, UX designers, and data teams to take concepts from zero to live products at scale.
